source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model’s transport capacity is 6, for **ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY** models only.

As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, you may divide 1 **SISTERS OF BATTLE SQUAD** of yours into 2 units as near equal in size as possible, noting which models form each. Then:

- one of the 2 must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**
- the other may begin embarked in a different **TRANSPORT** or be deployed on its own

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
